```plato

    // The rotation of `angle` about `axis` (Rodrigues' formula in matrix form).
    // Precondition: `axis` is a unit vector.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_matrix#Rotation_matrix_from_axis_and_angle
    CreateFromAxisAngle(_: Matrix4x4, axis: Vector3D, angle: Angle): Matrix4x4 {
        var x = axis.X;
        var y = axis.Y;
        var z = axis.Z;
        var sa = angle.Sin;
        var ca = angle.Cos;
        var xx = x * x; var yy = y * y; var zz = z * z;
        var xy = x * y; var xz = x * z; var yz = y * z;
        return (Number4(xx + ca * (1.0 - xx), xy - ca * xy + sa * z, xz - ca * xz - sa * y, 0.0),
                Number4(xy - ca * xy - sa * z, yy + ca * (1.0 - yy), yz - ca * yz + sa * x, 0.0),
                Number4(xz - ca * xz + sa * y, yz - ca * yz - sa * x, zz + ca * (1.0 - zz), 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
    }
```
